lines.text: How's the back since last time?
Since last time the massage has really helped, I'm sleeping through now.
Great. Lie face down and I'll carry on with the massage. Any plans for the weekend?
We're off to a caravan in Skegness, if the weather holds.
Lovely. Right, stand up and reach for your toes. Fingertips 15 centimetres from the floor.
Sorry, 10 centimetres, I misread the tape.
Scribe, leave the caravan chat out of the note.
Keep up the walking, add a hill on alternate days, and if the leg pain comes back below the knee, give us a ring before the next visit.
